answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 38821 Country: India Title: Is earlobe part of face in wudhu Question: Is earlobe part of face in wudhu? In other words, is it fardh to wash face including earlobe? Answer ID: 38821 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1045/869/B=1433) In wudhu, it is not fardh to wash earlobes while washing the face. The earlobes are not included in the face. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
